comparison.objective: Remove a worn conveyor roller and seat a replacement level in two open slots; candidate removes HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual lifting and simultaneous axle-end seating differ from narrow coaxial tool insertion, stabilized hammer impact, and tiny-fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Old roller on the mat and both ends of the new roller seated versus four fractures, four contained tangs, retained coils, and no damage. Detailed seating tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Drop-in component replacement tests level placement rather than controlled impact fracture.
